out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED AT HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. INSTALL PAPER TOWEL HOLDER AT HAND SINK.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK USED AS STORAGE.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CLEAR HAND SINK SO IT IS ACCESSIBLE AT ALL TIMES.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. NO HAND SOAP PROVIDED AT HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. INSTALL HAND SOAP DISPENSER OR PLACE CONTAINER OF HAND SOAP AT HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BOXES OF LYCHEE SYRUP STORED ON FLOOR UNDERNEATH PREP TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. MOVE FOOD OFF FLOOR AND ONTO SHELVES.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOXES OF SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS STORED ON FLOOR UNDERNEATH OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. MOVE ALL BOXES OFF FLOOR AND ONTO SHELVES.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM PRESENT DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WILL OCCUR ON OR AROUND 10 DAYS TO ENSURE A CFM IS PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.observation: The handwashing facility located NEAR THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. OBSERVED HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK USED AS STORAGE FOR CONTAINERS AND SOAP DISPENSER IN BASIN,.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed box of residential pest bait stations in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS instructed employee to discard residential pesticide. Pest issues should be the responsibility of a licensed pest control operator.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: VARIOUS SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SYRUPS NEAR COFFEE PREP.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. LABEL SECONDARY CONTAINERS WITH FOOD NAME.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: Onigiris made with house made mayonnaise which contains raw shell egg.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. -Please update onigiri menu to contain consumer advisory statement disclosure and reminder or change ingredients so no ingredients are raw.
